0: Chipley, Georgia June 3rd 19293 Ordinance governing the building of houses in the Town of Chipley
1:
BE IT ORDAINED by the Mayor and Council of the Town of Chipley, Georgia and {t is hereby ordained by authority of the same that from and after the passage of this act it shall be unlawful for any person or persons to build a house of any description within the Town limits without first obtaining a permit from the Mayor end Council of said Town of Chipley.

Any person doing so unless authorized by the proper authority of said Town shall be adjudged guilty of Disorderly conduct and upon conviction of said offense shall be fined not less than one dollar nor more than fifty dollars or work on the public streets for not less than one day nor more than 30 days either or both ant the discretion of Mayor and Council of the Town of Chipley, Georgia.

Read the first tine in a regular meeting June the 3rd 1929

Read the second time in a regular meeting July the ist 1929
2:
BE IT FPURTHER ORDAINED that all ordinances or parts of ordinances in conflict with this ordinance be and the same are hereby repealed.

Witness our official signature and the seal of the Town of Chipley, Georgia this the Ist day of July 1929

Attested O. D. Tucker Recorder
